basic_details.job_title: BEE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 23 Joint Director, Deputy Director and Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) is recruiting candidates for 23 vacancies including Joint Director (Technical), Joint Director (Non-Technical), Deputy Director (Technical), Deputy Director (Non-Technical), Assistant Director (Finance) and Assistant Director (HR) posts on a deputation basis. Candidates must forward their offline application in the prescribed proforma through proper channel to the Secretary, Bureau of Energy Efficiency on or before 30 October 2026. Qualifications and pay levels vary by post, with Joint Director posts offering Pay level-12 (Rs. 78,800-2,09,200), Deputy Director

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 30 October 2026 (within 30 days of publication in Employment News)
important_dates.previous applicant relaxation: Candidates who applied in response to the earlier advertisement dated 06.06.2026 need not apply afresh.

qualification.details: Age Limit: The maximum age-limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Joint Director (Technical): Holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 5 years regular service in pay level-11; plus Master degree in Economics, Physics, Mathematics, or Chemistry OR Bachelor degree in Engineering; plus energy auditor certificate; plus 10 years post-qualification experience in energy efficiency in industry, transport, or building. Joint Director (Non-Technical): Holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 5 years regular service in pay level-11; plus Bachelor’s degree OR MBA with specialisation in Finance/HR; plus 10 years post-qualification experience in establishment, administration, Accounts, or Vigilance. Deputy Director (Technical): Holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 5 years regular service in pay level-10; plus Master degree in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Economics OR Bachelor degree in Engineering; plus energy manager or energy auditor certificate; plus 5 years post-qualification experience in energy efficiency in industry, transport, or building. Deputy Director (Non-Technical): Holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 5 years regular service in pay level-10; plus Bachelor’s degree OR MBA with specialisation in Finance/HR; plus 5 years post-qualification experience in establishment, administration, Accounts, or Vigilance. Assistant Director (Finance): Holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 4 years service in pay level-8, or 5 years service in pay level-7; plus Bachelor's degree OR MBA in Finance; plus minimum 3 years experience in finance, accounts, and budget related works. Assistant Director (HR): Holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 4 years service in pay level-8, or 5 years service in pay level-7; plus Bachelor's degree OR MBA in Human Resources; plus minimum 3 years experience in general administration and establishment related works.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit applications for BEE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 30 October 2026, which is within 30 days of the publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of recruitment for these posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment for all posts including Joint Director, Deputy Director, and Assistant Director is conducted strictly by deputation.

faq.question: Q3. Where should the completed applications be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded through proper channel to the Secretary, Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Govt. of India, 4th Floor, Sewa Bhawan, R. K. Puram, New Delhi – 110066.

faq.question: Q4. What documents are required to accompany the application?
faq.answer: Applications must be accompanied by complete ACRs of the last 5 years, Vigilance Clearance, major/minor penalty statement of the last ten years, and two passport size photographs.

faq.question: Q5. Do candidates who applied previously need to apply again?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already applied in response to the earlier advertisement dated 06.06.2026 need not apply afresh as their earlier applications will be considered along with new ones.
